mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, display_name) VALUES (#{id}, #{displayName}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name
mapper.select: SELECT id, organization_id, user_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM organization_memberships WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
SELECT id, organization_id, user_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM organization_memberships WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
SELECT id, slug, name, status, default_timezone, data_retention_days, approval_policy, created_at, updated_at FROM organizations WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT count(*)::int FROM organization_memberships WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organizations (id, slug, name, status, default_timezone, data_retention_days, approval_policy) VALUES (#{id}, #{slug}, #{name}, 'active', #{timezone}, 90, #{policy, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler})
INSERT INTO organization_memberships (id, organization_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.display_name, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (#{status}::text IS NULL OR m.status = #{status}) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.display_name, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, 1 AS total FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.id = #{id}
SELECT count(*)::int FROM organization_memberships WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND role = 'owner' AND status = 'active' AND (#{excludingId}::text IS NULL OR id <> #{excludingId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization_memberships WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE organizations SET default_timezone = COALESCE(#{timezone}, default_timezone), data_retention_days = CASE WHEN #{setRetention} THEN #{retentionDays} ELSE data_retention_days END, approval_policy = COALESCE(#{policy, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, approval_policy), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'active') AS active_members, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM projects WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'active') AS active_projects, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM runs WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status IN ('queued','provisioning','running','waiting_for_approval','cancelling')) AS active_runs, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM approvals WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'pending') AS pending_approvals, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM connector_installations WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'available') AS active_connectors
